research_scope: Five previously absent early/base-game skills selected after repository duplicate checks. Quest identity is independently corroborated; unsupported reward-slot and technical fields remain unresolved.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked the current Xenoverse 2 skill guide, an independent PQ reward transcription, and skill-specific references where available.

records.name: Recoome Eraser Gun
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 17 — Ginyu and the Fruit
records.mechanics_notes: Skill-specific reference identifies Recoome Eraser Gun as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki and obtainable from PQ17. The move is a long-range beam with a startup animation. Exact reward-slot semantics and current drop conditions are not asserted.

records.name: Mach Kick
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 17 — Ginyu and the Fruit
records.mechanics_notes: The current skill guide and independent PQ reward transcription place Mach Kick in PQ17. Exact resource cost, hit count, damage, and reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Fighting Pose J
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 17 — Ginyu and the Fruit
records.mechanics_notes: PQ17 reward listings identify Fighting Pose J. Community acquisition reports distinguish its end-of-mission acquisition behavior from Recoome's immediately reported skill drops; no unsupported drop condition or probability is asserted here.

records.name: Time Control
records.mechanics_notes: Independent PQ reward listings place Time Control in PQ18. Current skill-guide data identifies it as the PQ18 skill alongside Mach Dash. Exact resource cost, duration, and reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Unrelenting Barrage
records.mechanics_notes: The current Xenoverse 2 skill guide places Unrelenting Barrage in PQ10 alongside Wall of Defense. It is recorded as a Strike Ultimate, while exact Ki cost, reward-slot semantics, and technical hit data remain unresolved pending a stronger skill-specific source.
